biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point and do not constitute a merge conclusion; weak pair separation does not recommend merge.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
No reclustering was performed, and no current-boundary normalized-cut, independent two-way spectral ARI, or union eigengap metrics were produced in this screen.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point and do not constitute a merge conclusion; weak pair separation does not recommend merge.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
No reclustering was performed, and no current-boundary normalized-cut, independent two-way spectral ARI, or union eigengap metrics were produced in this screen.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point and do not constitute a merge conclusion; weak pair separation does not recommend merge.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
No reclustering was performed, and no current-boundary normalized-cut, independent two-way spectral ARI, or union eigengap metrics were produced in this screen.

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the G2M checkpoint enrichment; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0008 exhibits a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: a strong, coordinated up-regulation of G2M checkpoint and E2F targets (nes ~2.0, fdr_q=0.001) with down-regulated interferon alpha/gamma responses and allograft rejection (nes -1.8 to -1.9, fdr_q=0.001). The leading-edge composition supports a proliferative/cell-cycle program. Per the evidence role, this characterizes biological identity only and does not by itself establish that the current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.

limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.value: HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION (down, nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001); HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE (down, nes=-1.790, fdr_q=0.0026); HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS (down, nes=-1.718, fdr_q=0.0052); HALLMARK_PROTEIN_SECRETION (down, nes=-1.626, fdr_q=0.0087); HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM (down, nes=-1.638, fdr_q=0.0094)
observations.meaning: Direction and strength of the most strongly enriched Hallmark programs relative to the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking, with GSEA multiple-testing-adjusted evidence.
observations.finding: K8_C0001 shows a coherent down-regulated metabolic program: oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion are all suppressed relative to the rest of the partition, with the strongest signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). Up-regulated programs are weaker and not significant (e.g., pancreas beta cells nes=1.238, fdr_q=0.127; EMT nes=1.250, fdr_q=0.129).

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the oxidative phosphorylation enrichment; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.
observations.finding: The OXPHOS leading edge is dominated by mitochondrial respiratory-chain and TCA-cycle genes (e.g., NDUF subunits, COX subunits, ATP5 subunits, SDHA/SDHC, MDH1/MDH2, IDH1/IDH2, FH, CS), consistent with a coordinated mitochondrial/metabolic suppression rather than an isolated single-gene effect.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 exhibits a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: a coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion, with the strongest and most significant signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). The leading-edge gene composition supports a mitochondrial/metabolic program rather than a scattered signal. Up-regulated programs are present but weaker and not significant at conventional multiplicity levels. Per the evidence role, this characterizes biological identity only and does not by itself establish that the current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.

Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point and do not constitute a merge conclusion; weak pair separation does not recommend merge.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
No reclustering was performed, and no current-boundary normalized-cut, independent two-way spectral ARI, or union eigengap metrics were produced in this screen.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0001–K8_C0004 boundary, current-label alignment is weak in the native modality geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.017 (CT), 0.063 (RNA), 0.058 (WSI), and 0.426 (WXS), with negative fractions of 0.25–0.54 and near-zero or negative medians in CT. Mean between-label distances exceed mean within-label distances in all four modalities, but the margins are small in CT (27.653 vs 27.544), RNA (0.989 vs 0.929), and WSI (0.192 vs 0.184), while the WXS margin is larger (0.748 vs 0.395). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is only weakly expressed in the CT, RNA, and WSI geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels, and more clearly expressed in WXS. Global GRV is significant for ct__rna, ct__wsi, and wsi__rna, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak overall. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.

Mean between-label distances are only marginally larger than within-label distances in CT (30.975 vs 30.734) and WSI (0.310 vs 0.305), and smaller in RNA (0.902 vs 0.929). In contrast, WXS shows a clearly positive mean silhouette (0.400, median 0.415, negative fraction 0.067) with a within/between margin (0.750 vs 0.446). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is not expressed in the CT, RNA, or WSI geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels, while it is clearly expressed in WXS. No modality pair shows significant global GRV, so GRV provides no supporting signal; per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the third-closest boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00924) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing essentially no separation between the two labels in CT, RNA, and WSI, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.

Up-regulated programs are weaker and not significant (e.g., pancreas beta cells nes=1.238, fdr_q=0.127; EMT nes=1.250, fdr_q=0.129).

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the oxidative phosphorylation enrichment; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 exhibits a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: a coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion, with the strongest and most significant signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). The leading-edge gene composition supports a mitochondrial/metabolic program rather than a scattered signal. Up-regulated programs are present but weaker and not significant at conventional multiplicity levels. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0004–K8_C0006 boundary, current-label alignment is weakly to modestly positive across the native modality geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.064 (CT), 0.048 (RNA), 0.124 (WSI), and 0.131 (WXS), with positive medians except WXS (median 0.0) and negative fractions of 0.26–0.42. Mean between-label distances exceed mean within-label distances in all four modalities, but the margins are small (e.g., CT 29.797 vs 27.009; WXS 0.828 vs 0.751). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is only weakly expressed in the available geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels. Global GRV is significant only for ct__wsi, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0004–K8_C0006 as the closest boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00926) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing only weak separation between the two labels, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0006–K8_C0008 boundary, current-label alignment is essentially absent in the CT, RNA, and WSI native geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.011 (CT), -0.030 (RNA), and -0.003 (WSI), with negative fractions of 0.33–0.73 and near-zero or negative medians. Mean between-label distances are only marginally larger than within-label distances in CT (30.975 vs 30.734) and WSI (0.310 vs 0.305), and smaller in RNA (0.902 vs 0.929). In contrast, WXS shows a clearly positive mean silhouette (0.400, median 0.415, negative fraction 0.067) with a within/between margin (0.750 vs 0.446). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is not expressed in the CT, RNA, or WSI geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels, while it is clearly expressed in WXS. No modality pair shows significant global GRV, so GRV provides no supporting signal; per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0006–K8_C0008 as the third-closest boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00924) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing essentially no separation between the two labels in CT, RNA, and WSI, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0002–K8_C0004 boundary, current-label alignment is weakly positive across the native modality geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.064 (CT), 0.113 (RNA), 0.143 (WSI), and 0.038 (WXS), with positive medians except WXS (median 0.0) and negative fractions of 0.19–0.38. Mean between-label distances exceed mean within-label distances in all four modalities, but the margins are small (e.g., CT 30.364 vs 28.840; WXS 0.971 vs 0.942). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is only weakly expressed in the available geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels. Global GRV is significant for ct__rna, rna__wxs, wsi__rna, and wsi__wxs, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0002–K8_C0004 as a relatively close boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00912) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing only weak separation between the two labels, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0002–K8_C0004 boundary, the current labels are moderately represented in the fused geometry: the independent two-way spectral partition of the union agrees with the current labels at ARI 0.704, and mean between-set affinity (0.00912) is below mean within-set affinity (0.00973), consistent with a weak but present boundary. The union's spectral structure is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (leading eigengap 0.997 at k=1 versus 0.022 at k=2), so the union lacks a dominant internal subdivision signal; per the guidance this is structurally compatible with treating the pair as one candidate and must not be interpreted as evidence against merge, but is not sufficient by itself to justify merge. The weak current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is compatible with removing the boundary, while the moderate ARI indicates the current labels are not arbitrary. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.

Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.value: HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION (down, nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001); HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE (down, nes=-1.790, fdr_q=0.0026); HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS (down, nes=-1.718, fdr_q=0.0052); HALLMARK_PROTEIN_SECRETION (down, nes=-1.626, fdr_q=0.0087); HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM (down, nes=-1.638, fdr_q=0.0094)
observations.meaning: Direction and strength of the most strongly enriched Hallmark programs relative to the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking, with GSEA multiple-testing-adjusted evidence.
observations.finding: K8_C0001 shows a coherent down-regulated metabolic program: oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion are all suppressed relative to the rest of the partition, with the strongest signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). Up-regulated programs are weaker and not significant (e.g., pancreas beta cells nes=1.238, fdr_q=0.127; EMT nes=1.250, fdr_q=0.129).

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the oxidative phosphorylation enrichment; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.
observations.finding: The OXPHOS leading edge is dominated by mitochondrial respiratory-chain and TCA-cycle genes (e.g., NDUF subunits, COX subunits, ATP5 subunits, SDHA/SDHC, MDH1/MDH2, IDH1/IDH2, FH, CS), consistent with a coordinated mitochondrial/metabolic suppression rather than an isolated single-gene effect.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 exhibits a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: a coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion, with the strongest and most significant signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). The leading-edge gene composition supports a mitochondrial/metabolic program rather than a scattered signal. Up-regulated programs are present but weaker and not significant at conventional multiplicity levels. Per the evidence role, this characterizes biological identity only and does not by itself establish that the current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

That structural screen is triage evidence only and does not establish biological meaning; the present transcriptomic phenotype is a distinct evidence dimension and is not in conflict with it.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the target-versus-rest contrast is not a clean two-group comparison.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0001–K8_C0008 boundary, the current labels are strongly represented in the fused geometry: the independent two-way spectral partition of the union agrees perfectly with the current labels at ARI 1.0, and mean between-set affinity (0.00919) is below mean within-set affinity (0.01023), consistent with a weak but present boundary. The union's spectral structure is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (leading eigengap 1.000 at k=1 versus 0.016 at k=2), so the union lacks a dominant internal subdivision signal; per the guidance this is structurally compatible with treating the pair as one candidate and must not be interpreted as evidence against merge, but is not sufficient by itself to justify merge. biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this round, so there is no earlier evidence to compare against.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only; they do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

The internal screen reports candidate_k=1 for all sets, so no feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements are available; absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point and do not constitute a merge conclusion; weak pair separation does not recommend merge.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
No reclustering was performed, and no current-boundary normalized-cut, independent two-way spectral ARI, or union eigengap metrics were produced in this screen.

observations.value: HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION (down, nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001); HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE (down, nes=-1.790, fdr_q=0.0026); HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS (down, nes=-1.718, fdr_q=0.0052); HALLMARK_PROTEIN_SECRETION (down, nes=-1.626, fdr_q=0.0087); HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM (down, nes=-1.638, fdr_q=0.0094)
observations.meaning: Direction and strength of the most strongly enriched Hallmark programs relative to the target-versus-rest Wald-statistic ranking, with GSEA multiple-testing-adjusted evidence.
observations.finding: K8_C0001 shows a coherent down-regulated metabolic program: oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion are all suppressed relative to the rest of the partition, with the strongest signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). Up-regulated programs are weaker and not significant (e.g., pancreas beta cells nes=1.238, fdr_q=0.127; EMT nes=1.250, fdr_q=0.129).

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the oxidative phosphorylation enrichment; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.
observations.finding: The OXPHOS leading edge is dominated by mitochondrial respiratory-chain and TCA-cycle genes (e.g., NDUF subunits, COX subunits, ATP5 subunits, SDHA/SDHC, MDH1/MDH2, IDH1/IDH2, FH, CS), consistent with a coordinated mitochondrial/metabolic suppression rather than an isolated single-gene effect.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 exhibits a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: a coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, fatty-acid metabolism, and protein secretion, with the strongest and most significant signal in oxidative phosphorylation (nes=-1.969, fdr_q=0.001). The leading-edge gene composition supports a mitochondrial/metabolic program rather than a scattered signal. Up-regulated programs are present but weaker and not significant at conventional multiplicity levels. Per the evidence role, this characterizes biological identity only and does not by itself establish that the current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0002–K8_C0003 boundary, the current labels are moderately represented in the fused geometry: the independent two-way spectral partition of the union agrees with the current labels at ARI 0.750, and mean between-set affinity (0.00925) is slightly below mean within-set affinity (0.00969), consistent with a weak but present boundary. The union's spectral structure is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (leading eigengap 0.998 at k=1 versus 0.013 at k=2), so the union lacks a dominant internal subdivision signal; per the guidance this is structurally compatible with treating the pair as one candidate and must not be interpreted as evidence against merge, but is not sufficient by itself to justify merge. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0001–K8_C0004 boundary, current-label alignment is weak in the native modality geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.017 (CT), 0.063 (RNA), 0.058 (WSI), and 0.426 (WXS), with negative fractions of 0.25–0.54 and near-zero or negative medians in CT. Global GRV is significant for ct__rna, ct__wsi, and wsi__rna, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak overall. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0004–K8_C0007 boundary, current-label alignment is weakly positive in the CT, RNA, and WSI native geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.030 (CT), 0.091 (RNA), and 0.098 (WSI), with positive medians and negative fractions of 0.25–0.46. Mean between-label distances exceed mean within-label distances in all four modalities, but the margins are small in CT (26.101 vs 25.411) and WSI (0.229 vs 0.215), moderate in RNA (1.021 vs 0.929), and larger in WXS (0.712 vs 0.365). WXS shows the largest positive mean silhouette (0.444, median 1.0, negative fraction 0.25). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is only weakly expressed in the CT, RNA, and WSI geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels, and more clearly expressed in WXS. Global GRV is significant only for wsi__rna, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak overall. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0004–K8_C0007 as a relatively close boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00914) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing only weak separation between the two labels, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and identifies relatively close candidate boundaries for possible pair review. All eight candidate sets screen at candidate_k=1, with a large leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (ranging from 1.0144 for K8_C0005 to 1.0729 for K8_C0006). Per the metric semantics, a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure; the screen therefore does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate. Mean within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.00965–0.01038), with K8_C0008 highest and K8_C0002 lowest. The nearest-pair affinities identify K8_C0004–K8_C0006 (0.00926), K8_C0002–K8_C0003 (0.00925), and K8_C0006–K8_C0008 (0.00924) as the relatively closest boundaries; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions. This is triage evidence only and does not by itself establish retention, split, or merge, nor biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0004–K8_C0006 boundary, the current labels are substantially represented in the fused geometry: the independent two-way spectral partition of the union agrees with the current labels at ARI 0.790, and mean between-set affinity (0.00926) is below mean within-set affinity (0.00997), consistent with a weak but present boundary. The union's spectral structure is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (leading eigengap 1.010 at k=1 versus 0.014 at k=2), so the union lacks a dominant internal subdivision signal; per the guidance this is structurally compatible with treating the pair as one candidate and must not be interpreted as evidence against merge, but is not sufficient by itself to justify merge. The weak current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is compatible with removing the boundary, while the substantial ARI indicates the current labels are not arbitrary. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0004–K8_C0006 as the closest boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00926) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: For the K8_C0004–K8_C0007 boundary, current-label alignment is weakly positive in the CT, RNA, and WSI native geometries: mean silhouettes are 0.030 (CT), 0.091 (RNA), and 0.098 (WSI), with positive medians and negative fractions of 0.25–0.46. Mean between-label distances exceed mean within-label distances in all four modalities, but the margins are small in CT (26.101 vs 25.411) and WSI (0.229 vs 0.215), moderate in RNA (1.021 vs 0.929), and larger in WXS (0.712 vs 0.365). WXS shows the largest positive mean silhouette (0.444, median 1.0, negative fraction 0.25). This indicates that the existing boundary between the two candidate sets is only weakly expressed in the CT, RNA, and WSI geometries, with substantial overlap between the two labels, and more clearly expressed in WXS. Global GRV is significant only for wsi__rna, but per the guidance GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support; the boundary-relevant signal is the current-label alignment, which is weak overall. This evidence bears directly on boundary representation but does not by itself determine whether the pair should be merged.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level structural screen (cross_modal_consistency, structural_diagnostics) identified K8_C0004–K8_C0007 as a relatively close boundary (mean between-set affinity 0.00914) and reported candidate_k=1 for both sets. The present native-geometry alignment is consistent with that screen in showing only weak separation between the two labels, but it is a distinct measurement (native-distance silhouette under the full partition) and does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

biological_support.role: Characterize whether the candidate has a coherent and interpretable biological identity or phenotype.
biological_support.request_focus: Ask whether the candidate shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population.
biological_support.does_not_establish: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

cross_modal_consistency.role: Evaluate whether current membership, boundary, internal structure, or granularity is represented in the multimodal patient geometry.
cross_modal_consistency.request_focus: Ask one question about either current membership or boundary representation in relevant patient geometries, or—when a split hypothesis could change the decision—internal subdivision. Do not combine membership representation and internal subdivision in one request.
cross_modal_consistency.does_not_establish: Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

confounder_exclusion.role: Evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, site, or related factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure.
confounder_exclusion.request_focus: Ask whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations at the requested scope. Partition scope concerns the partition as a whole; set scope concerns the target candidate relative to the rest. Do not imply target-specific confounding from partition-level evidence. Do not imply covariate adjustment, causal control, or persistence after adjustment unless the supplied analysis supports it.
confounder_exclusion.does_not_establish: Absence of a measured confounder association does not by itself positively establish biological identity or an independent boundary.

known_label_echo.role: Describe correspondence with clinical stratification or previously reported ccRCC taxonomies.
known_label_echo.request_focus: Ask only how the current partition corresponds to available clinical stratification or previously reported subtype taxonomies.
known_label_echo.does_not_establish: Known-label correspondence or non-correspondence does not by itself establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention.
